# Agent-loop ledger

Every finding the loop has made, and where it stands **now**. A pass reads
this first, so that pass 40 does not spend its budget rediscovering what
pass 3 wrote down, and does not re-file something closed as working as
intended.

One file per pass in [`passes/`](passes/), append-only. A later pass changes
a finding's state by writing its own heading for that id — the newest
mention wins, and this index is regenerated from all of them.
